fno_fire_distcond.label: FIRE residual
fno_fire_distcond.cite: FIRE, Yu, Sung & Ahmed 2026, scalar version
fno_fire_distcond.how: Field analogue of FIRE: an ensemble of coarse models supplies per-pixel mean and spread, and the correction is conditioned on both.

mf_fno_transfer_bar.label: concat transfer
mf_fno_transfer_bar.how: Same transfer schedule, but the parameters enter once as constant channels at the network input instead of by FiLM.

nomad_mf.label: NOMAD
nomad_mf.how: DeepONet with a nonlinear decoder, so the field is not restricted to a linear combination of basis functions.

mf_deeponet.label: MF-DeepONet, Lu
mf_deeponet.cite: Lu, Pestourie, Johnson, Romano 2022, PRR 4:023210, official code
mf_deeponet.how: A coarse DeepONet feeds a second DeepONet that learns the residual to the fine field.

mf_fno_transfer.label: plain transfer
mf_fno_transfer.how: Pretrain the operator on coarse data, then fine-tune every weight on the fine data at a lower learning rate.

mfrnp.label: MFRNP
mfrnp.cite: Niu et al., ICML 2024, official code
mfrnp.how: Neural process per level; the prediction sums the fine decoder and the upsampled residuals of the coarse ones.

convnext_unet_film.label: ConvNeXt-UNet FiLM
convnext_unet_film.cite: backbone: Liu et al. 2022 ConvNeXt + Ronneberger 2015 U-Net
convnext_unet_film.how: Your FiLM transfer recipe with the Fourier backbone swapped for a ConvNeXt U-Net. Isolates the backbone.

mf_fno_transfer_film.label: FiLM transfer
mf_fno_transfer_film.cite: builds on Lyu 2023 + Perez et al. 2018 FiLM
mf_fno_transfer_film.how: Your leaderboard winner. The parameters modulate every block through a learned scale and shift instead of entering as input channels.

fno_coregionalization.label: IFC coregionalization
fno_coregionalization.cite: Li et al., NeurIPS 2022 (IFC), upstream code
fno_coregionalization.how: Treats fidelity as a continuous coordinate and shares a low-rank basis across levels.

mf_fno_allpairs.label: all-pairs fidelity
mf_fno_allpairs.how: Trains on every ordered pair of fidelity levels rather than only coarse to fine, multiplying the training pairs.

wno_transfer_film.label: WNO transfer
wno_transfer_film.how: The same recipe again with a wavelet operator instead of a Fourier one.

st_hf_pod_gp.label: POD–GP, fine only
st_hf_pod_gp.how: Compress the fine fields with POD, fit one Gaussian process per coefficient. Uses no coarse data at all.

st_mean.label: mean field
st_mean.how: The mean of the fine training fields, ignoring the parameters entirely. An error of 1.0 means a method matched this.

st_lf_affine_pod.label: affine coarse surrogate
st_lf_affine_pod.cite: Zhang, Kim, Park, Haftka 2018, AIAA J. 56(12)
st_lf_affine_pod.how: Two numbers only: rescale and shift a coarse-only emulator by a least-squares fit on the fine rows.

st_knn.label: kNN in θ
st_knn.how: Inverse-distance average of the nearest training fields in parameter space, with k chosen by leave-one-out.

st_mfdnn.label: MF-DNN
st_mfdnn.how: Pointwise network for the coarse field, then a linear and a nonlinear head that correct it to the fine field.

st_nargp_pod.label: NARGP
st_nargp_pod.cite: Perdikaris et al. 2017, Proc. R. Soc. A 473
st_nargp_pod.how: Co-kriging made nonlinear: the fine level is a Gaussian process over both the parameters and the coarse prediction.

st_film_hf_only.label: FiLM, fine only
st_film_hf_only.how: Your FiLM network trained on the fine data only. Answers whether the coarse data helps at all.

st_koh_pod.label: co-kriging
st_koh_pod.how: The classical co-kriging model: fine equals rho times coarse plus a Gaussian-process discrepancy, fitted on POD coefficients.

st_mfdeeponet.label: MF-DeepONet, Howard
st_mfdeeponet.how: Composite DeepONet: separate linear and nonlinear correction networks, with the nonlinear one penalised.

st_dmfal.label: DMFAL
st_dmfal.how: Parameters to a latent code to the coarse field, then that latent plus the parameters to the fine field.

st_film_pooled.label: FiLM, pooled levels
st_film_pooled.how: All fidelity levels resampled and mixed into one training set with no fidelity flag, at the same optimiser-step budget as fine-only.

st_film_affine.label: FiLM, coarse + affine
st_film_affine.cite: control, formalised by Zhang et al. 2018
st_film_affine.how: The coarse-only network rescaled and shifted by two numbers fitted on the fine rows.

st_film_lf_only.label: FiLM, coarse only
st_film_lf_only.how: The same network trained on coarse data only, then scored against the fine target. The zero-fine-label floor.
